dedupe_keys.name: map dataset of critical raw materials hard rock deposits of europe 2024 gseu

description: This dataset lists the largest Critical Raw Materials hard rock deposits in Europe, sized super large, large or medium, based on the European Commission's 2023 CRM list. The Zenodo record says it was built from contributions of national and regional geological survey organisations collected from April to October 2024 in the EU-funded Geological Service for Europe project, with deposits sized by total endowment, the sum of past production, resources and reserves for each commodity. It was published in April 2025 by Capucine Albert and Guillaume Bertrand of the Bureau de Recherches Géologiques et Minières under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one Excel file of about 4 MB, alongside the published map. Coverage is Europe. Caveats: the record says it is a geological assessment only, ignoring infrastructure, processing, transport and socio-economic or environmental conditions, and a deposit does not imply future extractability. For simulation it gives the location and size of European critical mineral deposits to model domestic supply options and supply chain resilience. Related catalogue records include the GSEU offshore CRM occurrences dataset and the USGS global critical minerals mines, deposits and districts data.
